title: Anonymous appliance retailer stimulus (CXL description research): hedonic product copy (win)
company: Anonymous appliance retailer stimulus (CXL description research)

change.control: Utilitarian description of the blender, emphasizing technical utility.
change.variant: Reword the same features of the blender as pleasure/benefit-oriented hedonic copy; remove prices, logos and irrelevant information.

quote: Participants perceived the blender to be significantly more valuable when paired with the hedonic product description
notes: Bargain-question p=0.0129; too-expensive p<0.001. 304 survey participants across the study, not a published per-arm count. No purchases measured; household appliances only.
